entities.name: Aleksander Śliwka

entities.summary: Aleksander Śliwka  is a Polish professional volleyball player who plays as an outside hitter for Halkbank Ankara and the Poland national team. He won the silver medal in the Olympic Games Paris 2024. He is also the 2018 World Champion, and a three–time Champions League winner with ZAKSA.
